question.value: Constrain a possible cosmological variation of the proton-to-electron mass ratio mu using methanol absorption lines in the PKS1830-211 lensing galaxy at z=0.89, and quantify systematic effects

evidence.quote: A limit on a possible cosmological variation of the proton-to-electron mass ratio $\mu$ is derived from methanol (CH$_3$OH) absorption lines in the benchmark PKS1830$-$211 lensing galaxy at redshift $z = 0.89$
This paper makes use of the following ALMA data: ADS/JAO.ALMA$\#$2011.0.00405.S.
An observation of the $3_0-4_1A^+$ CH$_3$OH transition at a frequency of 261 GHz was conducted in June 2012
\[ALMA, 20 dishes, 12 m in diameter each; see Fig. [1](#Fig1)(c)\]
The angular resolution of the ALMA observations ($\sim$0.6 arcsec) made it possible to obtain a spectrum toward the south-western image only.
was conducted in June 2012 with the Atacama Large Millimeter/submillimeter Array

method.value: Fit absorption profiles to single Gaussians on an LSR velocity scale centred at z = 0.88582; IRAM blends fitted jointly with RADEX-based relative intensities

evidence.quote: The absorption profiles of individual transitions were fitted to single Gaussians, and the line positions and widths were determined on a Local Standard of Rest (LSR) velocity scale

validation.value: Uncertainty of blended line position estimated by varying relative strengths by 10-20%

evidence.quote: The uncertainty of the combined line position is estimated by varying the relative strengths of the three lines by 10-20$\%$ with regard to the RADEX prediction.

analysis_steps.goal: Fit Delta mu/mu from velocity vs K_mu

method.value: Fit 17 line positions with V/c = -K_mu Δμ/μ

evidence.quote: The velocities between different transitions are interrelated via $V/c= -K_{\mu}\Delta\mu/\mu$

assumptions.value: Laboratory frequency uncertainty negligible; calibration of frequency scale ≤20 m/s

evidence.quote: is small ($<$14$\%$) compared to the uncertainty obtained from the astrophysical spectra and is treated as negligible.

validation.value: Reduced chi2 = 10.2 (15 dof) shows an unaccounted systematic

evidence.quote: with a reduced $\chi^2_{\nu} = 10.2$, where the number of degrees of freedom, $\nu$, is 15.

method.value: Add E/A symmetry, excitation energy and observation epoch (quadratic) as independent variables; core-shift adopted as 1e-7 systematic

evidence.quote: A two-dimensional LR analysis with the observation epoch and $K_{\mu}$ as independent variables
a two-dimensional linear regression (LR) analysis with $K_{\mu}$ and $E$/$A$ symmetry as independent variables results in an increase of $\chi_{\nu}^2$, if compared to a fit with $K_{\mu}$ alone

used_for.value: Relative component intensities and methanol column density

evidence.quote: The RADEX radiative transfer model (cite: vandertak2007) was used to estimate the relative intensities.
$\Delta\mu/\mu = (1.5 \pm 1.5) \times 10^{-7}$
$\Delta\mu/\mu = (-1.0 \pm 0.8_{\rm stat} \pm 1.0_{\rm sys}) \times 10^{-7}$
this yields a total column density of $~1.6 \times 10^{14}$ cm$^{-2}$

findings_qualitative.value: E/A chemical segregation previously suggested is discarded

evidence.quote: The suggested systematic on $E/A$ chemical segregation (cite: Bagdonaite2013) has now been discarded.

claims.experiment: Fit 17 methanol line positions from Effelsberg, IRAM, ALMA vs K_mu
claims.finding: No variation detected, but the scatter implies unmodelled systematics

evidence.quote: purely statistical 1-$\sigma$ constraint of $\Delta\mu/\mu = (1.5 \pm 1.5) \times 10^{-7}$

claims.hypothesis: Systematics (segregation, temperature, time variability) explain the excess scatter

evidence.quote: a constraint of $\Delta\mu/\mu = (-1.0\pm0.8)\times 10^{-7}$ is delivered with $\chi_{\nu}^2 = 2.4$

alternatives_considered_or_rejected.value: E/A segregation rejected: 2D regression increased chi2_nu

evidence.quote: results in an increase of $\chi_{\nu}^2$, if compared to a fit with $K_{\mu}$ alone, thereby ruling out a possible $E$/$A$ segregation.

limitations_admitted.value: Core-shift effect cannot be estimated from current data; K_mu and 1/nu correlated

evidence.quote: As it is not possible to estimate the size of this effect based on the current data set, we adopt the latter value as a systematic uncertainty

referee_caveats_inferred: Only one ALMA line; ALMA role minor
Linear regression with several free variables on 17 points risks overfitting
Quadratic time dependence is ad hoc

missing_for_reproduction: Effelsberg and IRAM data are not identified as public
reproducibility.score_reason: Final table of line positions is given so the regression is reproducible, but raw data reduction is not described.
reproducibility.rediscovery_reason: Most data are single-dish non-ALMA and reduction is unstated.
